FULL TEXT:
TRANSLATOR AND TRANSLATOR-CUM-PROOF READER (FOR SUVAS CELL)
RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 38/R&A Dated: 11th June, 2025
In continuation of the Court’s Notice No. 34/R&A dated 16th May, 2025, all candidates
are hereby informed that their interview letters have been uploaded on Court’s official website
through a link available there. The candidates are directed to download the same and appear at
the interview as per their schedule date and time.
The candidates are further informed that there shall be a test of translation in Urdu/
Maithili/ Santhali on 17.06.2025 (Tuesday). The test will carry five (05) marks and its duration
will be of half an hour. Only candidates who have declared proficiency in any of these
languages in their application forms are eligible to participate. Their names, listed in
order of roll number, are included in Annexure-I.
Such candidates must report at 11:00 A.M. on 17th June 2025 (Tuesday) for the test at
the Portico of the Centenary Building within the premises of Patna High Court,
entering via Gate No. 5, with their interview letter.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the interview and test schedules, where
applicable. No request for any change to these schedules will be entertained.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the test as well as the Interview.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s official website regularly for
further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General I/c
